landmarks.what: inbound triage skips issues dross authored in any board.json namespace or carrying the dross marker label; milestone slot shape-gated so a numeric forge milestone id cannot suppress the same-numbered human issue

one close path for every backend: mapped state write on YouTrack/Jira, plain close elsewhere, and a read-back on the tracker's own verdict so dross never prints (closed) over an issue the tracker still holds open

task-sync validates and normalizes --status like phase-sync and gains --close (requires --status), routing each card through the verified close and recording its agreement point only after the tracker agrees

milestone-sync --close resolves the epic through the verified close path, refusing by name and writing nothing when the milestone entity is a version bundle, agile board or numeric forge milestone id; milestone.md emits it at finalize

backlog-sync closes the mirrors whose artefact resolved (scaffolded slug, dismissed idea, routed item whose target shipped), leaves and names anything it cannot attribute, keeps the link on a refused close, and gains the --phase form ship.md calls at finalize
the task lane gains its own terminal status mapped to YouTrack Verified and Jira Done, emitted once per phase from ship finalize; readable back off a card but never derived from a plan status

reflection over board.Board's map fields fails a namespace that escapes the inbound filter, and the same enumeration drives a guard that every mirror lane has a terminal emission in the prompt corpus whose status is distinct from that lane's working states
